title: Walk on the Ocean | Spacious 30A Beach Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Experience Walk on the Ocean, a spacious beach house in the WaterColor Lake District. Perfect for large groups and family gatherings.
description_expanded: Book Your Getaway Today & Save! Use Promo Code: WALKONTHEOCEAN at checkout for an exclusive introductory rate. For a limited time only. Holiday black out dates apply. Valid for arrival dates 1/22/26 - 4/22/26 Walk on the Ocean Classic WaterColor Charm in the Lake District Home Introduction Unwind in style at Walk on the Ocean , a beautifully designed WaterColor home located in the highly sought-after Lake District . The ideal layout for large families, including a separate carriage house apartment offering additional space for anyone in your group desiring more privacy. Enjoy popular amenities including the provided LSV, bikes, screened-in outdoor space, and convenient access to neighborhood pools. Surrounded by lush greenery and timeless Old Florida charm, this spacious retreat offers multiple indoor and outdoor gathering spaces-perfect for a peaceful and relaxing coastal getaway. Home Highlights Prime Lake District location in WaterColor One block to Sandhill (Frog) Pool and Park Two-minute LSV or bike ride to Camp WaterColor Complimentary access to a 6-seater LSV (golf cart) - waiver required, restrictions apply Five Taxi bikes for exploring WaterColor and 30A Main house full kitchen with stainless steel appliances, Keurig, and drip coffee maker Dining area with seating for 6 plus breakfast bar seating for 3 Screened-in porch with cushioned seating and outdoor dining table for 6 Outdoor propane grill Spacious great room with hardwood floors, high ceilings, and warm coastal tones Second-floor TV room with Smart TV Separate carriage house apartment with full kitchen, living room, and private laundry closet Dedicated parking for 3 vehicles (garage access not available) Smart TVs, WiFi, and cable throughout the home Outdoor shower First-floor laundry room with HE washer and dryer Office nook with desk and chair on the first floor Location Perks Steps to Sandhill (Frog) Pool and neighborhood park Minutes to Camp WaterColor amenities Easy bike and LSV access to WaterColor Beach Club Close to 30A dining, shopping, and coastal activities Know Before You Go Access to the WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor and all community pools is included for 14 guests ages 5 and up Community pools are heated during cooler months, and towel service is available (subject to neighborhood changes) A mid-stay clean is required for reservations of 10 days or longer and is included in your rate Additional cleans may be scheduled for an additional fee Concierge services available, including baby equipment rentals, additional bike rentals, grocery delivery, and catering Construction nearby - no refunds issued for noise or views during building * One promotion or discount per reservation. Promotions or discounts cannot be combined
